title: NBA Investigates Kawhi Leonard and Clippers for Salary Cap Circumvention
summary: The NBA has concluded its investigation into Kawhi Leonard and the Los Angeles Clippers regarding allegations of salary cap circumvention. The league announced on Wednesday that it has issued punishments to Leonard, his associates, and team executives. The specific details of the investigation and the penalties imposed were not disclosed in the provided coverage.
summary_points: The NBA completed an investigation into Kawhi Leonard and the Los Angeles Clippers.
The investigation concerned allegations of salary cap circumvention.
Punishments were issued to Leonard, his inner circle, and team executives.
The NBA announced the conclusion of the investigation on Wednesday.
